And We shall set balances of justice for the Day of Judgement. Then no one will be wronged at all if it be but the weight of a grain of mustard-seed, We shall bring it; and suffice We as reckoners.
And assuredly We gave to Musa and Harun the distinction and illumination and an admonition for the God-fearing.
Those who fear their Rabb, and who are fearful of the Hour.
And this is an admonition blessed, which We have sent down; will you then be its rejectors?
And assuredly We gave rectitude to Ibrahim afore-time, and him We had ever known.
Recall when he said to his father and his people: what are these images which you are bowing to?
They said: We found our fathers their worshippers.
He said: Assuredly you, you and your fathers have been in error.
They said: Have you come to us in seriousness, or are you among those who sport?
He said: Aye! Your Rabb is the Rabb of the heavens and the earth Who created them; and of that I am among the witnesses.
And by Allah, I am surely going to devise a plot against your idols, after you have turned your backs.
Then he made them fragments, all except the big one of them, that perhaps to it they may return.
They said: Who has done this to our gods? Surely he is of the evil-doers.
They said among themselves: We heard a youth, called Ibrāhīm speak of them with disrespect.
They said: Bring him then before the eyes of the people, perhaps they may bear witness.
They said: Are you the one who has done this to our gods? Ibrahim
He said: Rather he has done it, the big one of them; so question them, if they ever speak.
They then turned to themselves and said: You it is who are the evil-doers.
Thereafter they were put to utter confusion, saying: Certainly you know that they speak not.
He said: Do you worship them besides Allah, what can neither profit you nor hurt you.
Fie upon you and upon what you worship besides Allah, will you not then reflect?
They said: Burn him and succour your gods, if you will be doing.
We said: O Fire! be coolness and safety for Ibrāhīm.
And they wanted to do him harm, but We made themselves the worst losers.
And We delivered him and Lūṭ, to the land in which We had placed the blessings for the worlds.
And We bestowed upon him Ishāq and Ya'qūb as a grandson, and each one We made righteous.
And We made them leaders, guiding by Our Command, and We revealed to them the doing of good deeds and the establishment of Şalāt and the giving of Zakāt, and of Us they were the worshippers.
And as to Lut; We gave him judgement and knowledge, and We delivered him out of the city which had been working foul deeds; verily they were a people evil, wicked.
And We caused him to enter Our Mercy, verily he was of the righteous.
And as to Nūḥ, recall when he cried aforetime; We answered him and delivered him and his household from a mighty disaster.
We succoured him against a people who belied our signs, verily they were a people evil, so we drowned them all.
And as to Daūd and Sulaiman, recall when they gave judgment regarding the tillage when certain people’s sheep had pastured therein at night, and of the judgment concerning them We were the witnesses.

So We gave insight into it to Sulaiman, and to each of the two We gave judgment and We gave judgment and knowledge. And We so subjected the mountains that they should hallow Us along with Daud, and also the birds, and We were the doers.
And We taught him the art of making the coats of mail for you that it may protect you in battle; are you then thankful?
And to Sulaiman We subjected the wind, strongly raging, running at his command towards the land, wherein We had placed Our blessing, and of everything We are the Knowers.
And of the devils were some who dived for him, and worked a work besides that; and of them We were the Watchers.
And as to Ayyūb, recall when he cried to his Rabb: Verily affliction has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

So We answered him, and We removed from him what was with him of the affliction, and We gave restoration to him his household and along with them the like thereof as a Mercy from Us and a remembrance to the devotees.
And as to Ismā'il and Idris and Zul-kifl! Each was steadfast.
And We caused them to enter Our Mercy, verily they were of the righteous.

And as to Zun-nun, recall when he departed with anger and imagined that We could have no power over him, and then he cried in the layer of darknesses, there is no god but You hallowed be You! verily I have been of the wrong-doers.
So We answered him and We delivered him from the distress; and thus do We deliver the believers.
And as to Zakariyya, recall when he cried to his Rabb: Rabb! leave me not heirless though You are the best of inheritors.

So We answered him and bestowed on him Yahyā and We made sound for him his spouse. Verily all of them used to vie with one another in good deeds and to call upon Us with longing and dread, and they were before Us meek.
And as to she who guarded her chastity, We breathed into her of Our Spirit, and made her and her son a Sign unto the worlds.
Verily this community of yours is a single community, and I am your Rabb; so worship Me.
And they split up their affair among them, all shall return to Us.
Whosoever works righteous deeds, and he is a believer, there shall be no denial of his endeavour, and We are for him the writers.
And a ban is laid on every town which We have destroyed that they shall not return.
Until when Gog and Magog are let out and from every mound they are trickling down.
And there shall approach the true Promise, and lo! The eyes of the disbelieving shall be staring. Woe to us! surely we have been unheeding: Aye! we have been the wrong-doers.
Verily you and whatever you worship besides Allah shall be firewood for Hell: You shall go down to it.
Had these been gods, they would not have gone down to it, and all of them shall abide therein.
Theirs shall be roaring therein, and therein they shall hear not.
Verily those for whom good reward has preceded from Us, they shall be kept far away therefrom.
They shall not hear a whisper of it, and they shall abide in that felicity for which their souls long.
They, the Great Terror shall not grieve, and angels shall meet them: this is your Day which you were ever promised.
The Day when We shall roll up the heavens like as the rolling up of a scroll for books. Even as We began the first creation. We shall restore it: a Promise binding upon Us; verily We are the doers.
Surely We have written in the Scripture after the admonition that the land! My righteous bondmen will inherit it.
Verily in this is a preaching for a people who are true worshippers.
And We have not sent you except as a mercy to the worlds.
Say you: This only has been revealed to me: Your god is only One God; do you submit then?
Then if they turn away, say you: I have proclaimed to you all alike; and I do not know whether nigh or far is what you are promised.
"He knows what is spoken aloud, and He knows that you hide.
I do not know: May be it is a trial for you, and an enjoyment for a season.
He says: Rabb! Judge You with truth. And our Rabb is the Compassionate Whose help is sought against what you utter.
O mankind! Fear your Rabb; the quake of the Hour is to be a thing mighty.

The Day when you behold it, every suckling woman shall forsake what she suckles, and every pregnant woman shall lay down her burden; and you shall perceive mankind as drunk; whereas drunk they will be not, but the torment of Allah shall be terrible.
And of mankind is he who disputes respecting Allah without knowledge, and follows any devil froward.
Against whom it is prescribed; whosoever befriends him, him he shall lead astray and shall guide him on to the torment of Flame.

O mankind! if you be in doubt respecting the Resurrection, then know We have created you of the dust, then of a drop, then of a clot, then of a piece of flesh, fashioned and unfashioned, that We might manifest to you Our Power. And We settle into the wombs what We will for a term determined. Then We bring you forth as babies, and then We let you reach your maturity. And of you is he who dies early and of you is he who is brought back to the most abject age, so that after knowing he knows not aught. And you see the earth withered up, and when We send down on it water, it stirs and swells, and it grows all manner of luxuriant growth.
That is so, because Allah! He is the Truth, and He quickens the dead, and verily He is Potent over everything.
And because the Hour is coming there is no doubt about it and because Allah will rise up those who are in the graves.
And of mankind is he who disputes respecting Allah without knowledge or guidance or an illuminating Book.
Magnifying himself that he may lead others astray from the way of Allah; for him shall be humiliation in this world, and on the Day of Judgment We will make him taste the torment of burning.
That is because of what your hands have sent forth. And verily Allah never wrongs His creatures.

And of mankind is he who worships Allah upon the very edge; if there happens to him any good he is contented with it, but if there befalls him a trial, he turns round on his face. He loses both this world and the Hereafter, that indeed is a manifest loss.
He calls upon that, besides Allah, what can neither hurt nor profit him. That indeed is a straying far-off.
He calls upon him from whom harm is much nearer than benefit; surely ill the comrade! ill the comrade!
Verily Allah shall make those who believe and work righteous deeds enter Garden with running streams. Verily Allah performs whatsoever He intends.

Whosoever has been imagining that Allah will not make him (the Holy Prophet SAW) triumphant in this world and the Hereafter let him stretch a cord up to the heaven and let him look if his guile can do away that at what he enrages.
And thus We have sent it down as evidences, and verily Allah guides whom He intends.

Verily those who believe and those who are Judaised and the Sabians and the Nazarenes and the Magians and those who associate verily Allah will decide between them on the Day of Judgment; verily Allah is over everything a Witness.

See you not that Allah! Him adores whosoever is in the heavens and on the earth, and the sun and the moon and the mountains and the trees and the beasts and many of mankind? And there are many of them on whom torment is justified. And whom Allah despises, none can honour And Allah does whatsoever He wills.
These two are opponents who contended respecting their Rabb; then as for those who disbelieved, raiment's of fire shall be cut out for them, and hot water shall be poured over their heads.
Melted thereby shall be what is in their bellies and so their skins.
And for them shall be hooked rods of iron.
So oft as they, because of anguish, would seek to go forth, they shall be sent back to it. Taste the torment of burning.

Verily Allah will make those who believe and work righteous deeds enter Gardens with running streams, where they will be bedecked with bracelets of gold, and with pearls, and their garment therein will be of silk.
Guided they have been unto goodly speech and guided they have been to the path of the Praiseworthy.

Verily those who disbelieve and hinder others from the path of Allah and from the Sacred Mosque which We have made for mankind, equal in respect of which are the dweller therein and the stranger. Whosoever will seek profanity therein wrongfully, we shall make him taste of an afflictive torment.

Recall when We settled for Ibrāhīm the place of the House, saying: associate not then with Me anything, and keep pure My House for those who circumambulate and those who stand up and those who bow and prostrate themselves.
And proclaim you among mankind the pilgrimage; they shall come to you on foot and on any lean mount, coming from every deep defile.
That they may witness the benefits to them and may mention the name of Allah on the days known over the beast of cattle with which He has provided them. So eat of it, and feed the hungry poor.
Thereafter let them cleanse their unkemptness and fulfil their vows and circumambulate the Ancient House.

Thus it is. And whosoever respects the Ordinances of Allah it will be better for him with his Rabb. And allowed to you are the cattle, save what have been rehearsed unto you; so avoid the pollution of the idols, and avoid the falsehood.

Reclining unto Allah, not associating anything with Him. And whosoever associates anything with Allah, it is as though he had fallen from the sky and birds had snatched him away or the wind had swept him to a remote place.
Thus it is. And whosoever venerates the rites of Allah, and then it is from the piety of the hearts.
In them there are benefits for you for an appointed term, and thereafter the destination is towards the Ancient House.

And in every community We have appointed a ritual, so that they may mention the name of Allah over the beast cattle with which He has provided them, and your god is One God, so unto Him submit. And bear you glad tidings to the humble.
Those whose hearts, when Allah is mentioned, are filled with awe, and who patiently endure what befalls them, and those who establish the Şalāt, and spend of what We have provided them.

And camels! We have appointed them for you among the landmarks of Allah; for you is good in them. So mention them the name of Allah, standing in rows. Then when they fall down on their sides, eat of them, and feed the contented and the suppliant. Thus We have subjected them to you that perchance you may return thanks.

It is neither their flesh nor their blood that reaches Allah, but it is piety from you that reaches Him. He has subjected them to you that you may magnify Allah for He has guided you, and give you glad tidings to the well-doers.
Verily Allah will repel infidels from those who believe; verily Allah loves not any treacherous, ingrate.
Permission to fight is given to those who are fought against, because they have been oppressed, and verily Allah is Potent over their succour.

Those who have been banished from their abodes unjustly because they say: Our Rabb is Allah. And were it not for Allah's repelling of some by means of others, cloisters and churches, synagogues and mosques wherein the name of Allah is mentioned much would have been pulled down. Surely Allah shall succour him who succours Him; Surely Allah is Strong, Mighty.
Those who, if We establish them in the land, will establish the Şalāt and pay Zakāt and command what is reputable and restrain what is disreputable; and unto Allah is the end of all affairs.
And if they belie you, surely there have been before them the people of Nūḥ and the A'ād and the Thamūd.
And the people of Ibrāhīm and the people of Lūṭ.
And the inhabitants of Madyan, and belied was Mūsa. I gave rein to the infidels. Then I seized them, so how has been My Wrath.
How many a town have We destroyed, while it was a wrong-doer and it lies outward on its roofs, and how many a well abandoned and how many a castle fortified!

Have they not journeyed in the earth, so that there might become unto them hearts to understand with, or ears to hear with? Surely it is not the sights that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts that are in the bosoms.
And they ask you to hasten on the chastisement, whereas Allah shall not fail His Promise. And a Day with the Rabb is a thousand years of what you compute.
And how many a town did I give reins to, while it wronged itself? then I seized it. And unto Me is the return
Say you: mankind! I am to you only a manifest warner.
Then those who believe and work righteous deeds for them is forgiveness and an honourable provision.
And those who endeavour in respect of Our Signs to frustrate them; those shall be the inmates of the Flaming Fire.

And We have sent before you no Messenger or Prophet but as he recited, Satan cast forth suggestions in respect of the recital. Then Allah abolishes what Satan casts forth, and Allah continues His Revelations; and Allah is Knowing, Wise.
That He may make what Satan casts forth a temptation for those in whose hearts is a disease and whose hearts are hardened, and the ungodly are in divergence far-off

And that those who have been given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Rabb and may believe therein, and so their hearts may submit to it. And verily Allah is the Guide of those who believe in a straight path.
And those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt concerning it until the Hour comes upon them on a sudden, or there comes upon them the torment of a disastrous Day.
The dominion on that Day will be Allah's; He shall decide between them. Then those who believed and worked righteous deeds shall be in the Gardens of Delight.
And those who disbelieved and belied Our Signs then these! for them shall be an ignominious torment.
And those who emigrated in the Way of Allah, and then they were slain or they died, surely Allah will provide them with a goodly provision; and surely Allah! He is the Best Provider.
Of a surety He will make them enter an entrance with which they will be well-pleased, and Allah is Knowing, Forbearing.
That is so. And whoever chastises the like of what he was injured and then he has again been oppressed, surely Allah will succour him: verily Allah is Pardoning, Forgiving.
That is to be because Allah plunges night into day and plunges day into night, and because He is Hearing, Beholding.
That is because Allah! He is the Truth, and what they call upon besides Him it is the false. Verily Allah! He is the High, the Great.
Do you not see that Allah sends down water from the sky, and the earth becomes green? Verily Allah is Subtle, Aware.
His is whatever is in the heavens and on the earth; and verily Allah! He is the Self-sufficient, the Praiseworthy.

Do you not see that Allah has subjected to you whatsoever is on the earth and the ships running in the sea by His Command? And He withholds the heaven that it fall not on the earth save by His leave. Verily Allah is unto mankind Clement, Merciful.
He it is Who gave you life and will thereafter cause you to die, and will thereafter give you life again, verily man is ingrate.
For every community We have ordained a ritual which they observe. Let them not therefore contend with you in the affair, and call them you to your Rabb; verily you are on true guidance.
And if they dispute with you, say you: Allah knows best what you do.
Allah will judge between you on the Day of Judgment concerning that wherein you have been differing.
Do you not know that Allah knows whatsoever is in the heaven and the earth? Verily that is in the Book, and verily that is for Allah easy.
They worship beside Allah, that for which He has sent down no authority and that of which they have no knowledge, and for the ungodly there shall not be any helper.

And when Our manifest verses are rehearsed unto them, you find repugnance on the faces of those who disbelieve; they seem to spring upon those who rehearse Our verses to them. Say you: Shall I declare to you something more grievous than the Fire? Allah has indeed promised to those who disbelieve, an evil destination!

O mankind! a similitude is propounded; listen to it. Verily those whom you call upon beside Allah can by no means create a single fly, even though all of them assembled for that, and if a fly were to snatch away anything from them, they cannot restrain it. Feeble indeed are the seeker and the sought!
They have not estimated Allah His rightful estimate; verily Allah is Strong, Mighty.
Allah chooses Messengers from the angels and the mankind; Verily Allah is Hearing, Beholding.
He knows what is before them and what is behind them and to Allah are returned all affairs.
O you who believe! bow down and prostrate yourselves and worship your Rabb, and do good; haply you may thrive.

And strive hard for Allah as is due unto Him. Hard striving. He has distinguished you, and has not laid upon you any narrowness in religion: the faith of your father Ibrāhim. He has named you Muslim before, and in this, that the Messenger may be witness against you and that you may be witnesses against mankind. So establish the Salāt and pay Zakāt, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Patron, an Excellent Patron, and an Excellent Helper!
Blissful are the believers.
Those who in their Şalāt are lowly.
And those who turn away from everything vain.
And those who are doers for the sake of purification.
And those who are guards of their private parts.
Save in regard to their wives and those whom their right hands own so they are not blameworthy.
And those who crave beyond that, then it is they who are the transgressors.
And those who are keepers of their trusts and covenant.
And those who are observant of their Şalāt.
These! they are indeed the inheritors;
Who shall inherit Paradise; therein they shall abide.
Assuredly We created man out of an extract of clay.
Thereafter We made him a sperm in a safe receptacle.

Thereafter We made the sperm a clot; then We made the clot a lump of flesh; then We made the lump of flesh bones; then We clothed the bones with flesh; thereafter We brought him forth as another creature. Blessed be then Allah, the Best of Creators.
Then thereafter you are sure to die.
Then verily on the Day of Judgment you shall be raised up.
And assuredly We created above you seven paths; and of the creation We have not been neglectful.
And We sent down from the heaven water in measure, and We Command it to settle in the earth; and verily We are Able to take it away.
Then for you We brought forth with it the gardens of palm and vines; for you therein are many fruits, and thereof you eat
And a tree that springs forth from the Mount of Sinai, that grows oil and is a sauce for the eaters
And verily in the cattle there is a lesson for you. We give you to drink of what is in their bellies, and for you in them are many advantages, and of them you eat.
And you are borne on them and on the ship.
Assuredly We sent Nuh to his people, and he said: My people! Worship Allah, for you there is no god but He, will you then not be God-fearing?

Then the chiefs of them who disbelieved among his people said: This is no other than a human being like you; he seeks to make himself superior to you; and if Allah had willed He would have sent down angels; we have not heard of this among our ancient fathers.
He is only a man in whom is madness, so wait for him a season.
Nūh said: Rabb! Vindicate me, for they are denying me.

Then We revealed unto him saying: Build an ark under Our eyes and under Our Revelation; then when Our Command comes and boils over, make way therein of every pair and your household save him thereof against whom the word has already gone forth, and do not petition Me regarding those who have done wrong; they are certain to be drowned.
And when you are settled in the ark, you and those with you say: Praise to Allah Who has delivered us from the wrongdoing folk.
And say you: Rabb! Cause me to land at a landing blessed; and You are the Best of those who bring to land.
Verily in that are Signs; verily We have ever been testing.
Then after them We produced another generation.
Then We sent among them a Messenger from among themselves, saying! Worship Allah; for you there is no god but He; will you not fear Him?

The chiefs of them who disbelieved among the people and denied the meeting of the Hereafter and whom We had luxuriated in the life of the world, said: This is no other than a human being like you, he eats of what you eat and he drinks of what you drink.
And were you to obey a human being like you, you are forthwith to be losers.
Does he make promise to you that when you are dead and become dust and bones, you are to be brought forth?
Away! Away with what you are promised:
Naught there is but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we are not going to be raised up.
The Messenger said: Rabb! Vindicate me, for they are denying me.
Allah said: After a while they will be remorseful.
Then, a shout got hold of them in truth, and We made them a refuse; so away with the ungodly people!
Then after them, We brought forth another generation.
No community can anticipate their term; nor can they lay behind.

Then after them We sent Our Messengers successively. But no sooner did there come to a community their Messenger than they belied him. So We made them follow one another, and We made them by-words. So away with a people who do not believe.
Thereafter We sent Musa and his brother Harun with Our Signs and manifest authority;
To the Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they waxed proud and they were a people self-exalting.
So they said: Shall we believe in two human beings like us, while their community is a subject to us?
Then they belied the twain; and so they became of the destroyed.
And of a surety We gave Mūsa the Book that perchance they may be guided.
And We made the son of Maryam and his mother a Sign; and We sheltered them on a height; a quiet abode and running water.
O you Messengers! Eat of the good things and work righteous deeds; I am the Knower of what you do.
And verily this religion of yours is one religion, and I am your Rabb; so fear Me.
Then they cut their affair among them in regard to the Scripture, each sect rejoicing in what is with it.
So leave you them in their bewilderment for a season.
Do they imagine that in the wealth and children with which We enlarge them.
We are hastening them on to good things? Aye! They perceive not.
Verily those who go in awe for fear of their Rabb.
And those who believe in the Signs of their Rabb.
And those who do not join anyone with their Rabb.
And those who give whatsoever they give while their hearts are anxious that to their Rabb they are to be returned.
These are hastening on to good, and they are foremost therein.
We do not tax any soul except according to its capacity and with Us is a Book speaking with truth; and wronged they will not be.
Aye! Their hearts are in bewildement in respect of this, and they have, besides that, works of which they are the workers.
Until when We lay hold of the luxurious ones of them with the chastisement, and lo! They are imploring!
Implore not today, verily you are not to be succoured against Us.
Surely My Signs have been rehearsed to you, and you used to draw back upon your heels.
Stiff-necked, discoursing of it by night, reviling.
Did they never ponder over the Word? Or did there come to them what had not come to their forefathers?
Or, is it that they did not recognize their Divine Messengers, so they became his deniers?
Or, do they say: in him is madness? Aye! He brought them the truth, yet most of them are averse to the truth.

And were the truth to follow their desires there would have been corrupted the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is therein. Aye! We have come to them with their admonition; so it is from their admonition that they turn away.
Or, is it that you ask of them any maintenance? Better is the maintenance of your Rabb, and He is the Best of Providers.
Verily you! You call them to a path straight.
And verily those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
And though We may have Mercy on them and may remove whatsoever is of hurt with them, surely they would persist in their exorbitance, wandering perplexed.
And assuredly We seized them with chastisement, but they did not humble themselves to their Rabb, nor did they entreat.
Until when We shall open upon them a portal of severe torment, and lo! They are despairing.
And He it is Who brought forth for you hearing and sight and hearts; little thanks you return!
And He it is Who spread you on the earth and to Him you will be gathered.
And He it is Who gives life and causes to die; and His is the alternation of night and day, will you not then reflect?
Aye! they say the like of what the ancients said.
They say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be raised up indeed?
Certainly this we have been promised, we and our fathers before; but nothing is this but the fables of the ancients.
Say you: Whose is the earth and whose ever is therein, if you know?
They will surely say! Allah's. Say you: Will you not then heed?
Say you: Who is Rabb of the seven heavens and Rabb of the Mighty Throne?
They will certainly say: Allah. Say you: Will you not then be God-fearing?
Say you: In whose hand is the sovereignty of everything and who protects all, but against whom there is no protector, if you know?
They will certainly say: Allah's. Say you: How then are you turned away?
Aye! We have brought them the truth, and verily they are the liars.

Allah has not taken to Himself any son, and there is no god along with Him; else each god would have gone off with what he had created and one of them would have exalted himself above others. Hallowed be Allah above what they describe.
Knower of the unseen and the seen. Exalted is He above what they associate.
Say you: Rabb! if You will show me that with which they are threatened.
Rabb! then place me not among the wrong-doing folk.
And surely We are Able to show them that with which We threaten them.
Repel you the evil with what is the best; We are the Best Knower of what they utter.
And say you: Rabb if I seek refuge with You from the whisperings of the devils;
And Rabb! I seek refuge with You lest they may attend me.
It ceases not until when death comes to one of them and he says: Rabb! Send me back;
That I may work righteously in what I have left. By no means. It is but a word he utters, and in front of them is a barrier until the Day when they shall be raised.
Then when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no kinship among them that Day, nor will they be able to ask of each other.
Then he whose scales will be heavy-these! They are the blissful ones.
And he whose scales will be light-these are they who have hurt themselves; in Hell they shall abide.
Their faces the Fire shall scorch, and therein they shall be grinning.
Have not My Revelations been rehearsed to you, and them you have been belying?
They will say: Our Rabb! Our wretchedness overcame us and we have been an erring people.
O’ Our Rabb! Take us forth from it, then if we revert we shall be wrong-doers indeed.
Allah will say: Slink away in it, and speak not to Me.
Verily there was a band of my bondmen who said: Our Rabb! We have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the Best of the merciful ones.
Then you took them mockingly, so that they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, and at them you used to laugh.
Verily I have recompensed them today, for they bore patiently; verily they are the achievers.
Allah will say: How long did you stay on the earth in years?
They will say: We stayed a day or part of a day; question them who keep count.
Allah will say: You stayed a little indeed; would that you had known that in your lifetime.
Do you consider that We have created you in vain and that to Us you are not to return?
So exalted be Allah, the True King! There is no god but He! Rabb of the Honoured Throne.
And whosoever calls along with Allah unto another god, of whom he has no proof, then his reckoning is only with his Rabb; surely the infidels will not thrive.
And say you: Rabb! Forgive and have Mercy. You are the Best of the merciful ones.
This is a chapter We have revealed and enjoined, and herein We have sent down revelations manifest, that perchance, you may be admonished.

The adulteress and the adulterer: Scourge each of the two with a hundred stripes. And let not tenderness in the Law of Allah take hold of you in regard to the two, if you have come to believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a band of the believers witness this chastisement.
The adulterer weds not but an adulteress or an associatress: and the adulteress! - none weds her save an adulterer or an associator, and that is forbidden to the believers.
And those who accuse clean women and then bring not four witnesses. Scourge them with eighty stripes and accept not their testimony for ever. And these! They are the transgressors.
Excepting those who shall repent thereafter and make amends. Verily Allah is Forgiving. Merciful.
And as for those who accuse their wives and there are not witnesses for them except themselves, the testimony of one of them shall be to swear four times by Allah that he is truthful.
And for the fifth time that the curse of Allah be upon him, if he be of the liars.
And it will avert the chastisement from her if she swears by Allah four times that he is of the liars.
And for the fifth time that Allah's Wrath be upon her if he is of the truth-tellers.
And had it not been for the Grace of Allah and His Mercy upon you, and that Allah is Relenting, Wise, you had been lost.

Verily those who brought forward the calumny were a small band among you. Do not consider it an evil for you; nay, it was good for you. Unto every one of them shall be what he has earned of the sin, and he among them who took the bulk of it, for him shall be mighty torment.
Why, therefore, did not the faithful men and women, when you heard the slander, think well of their own people and say: this is an evident calumny?
Why did not they produce four witnesses thereof? And since they could not produce four witnesses, those! With Allah, they are the very liars!
Had there not been Allah's Grace upon you and His Mercy in the world and the Hereafter, surely there would have visited you a severe chastisement for that wherein you had rushed.
When you were spreading it with your tongues and saying with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge, you consider it light but with Allah it was great.
And why, when you heard it, did you not say: It is not for us to speak thereof, hallowed be You! That is a slander mighty?
Allah exhorts you not to repeat the like of it, if you are believers.
And Allah expounds to you His Revelations; and Allah is Knowing, Wise.
Verily those who desire that indecency should be propagated among the faithful for them shall be an afflictive chastisement in the world and the Hereafter. Allah Knows and you know not.
And had there not been Allah's Grace upon you and His Mercy, and that Allah was Tender and Merciful, you could have perished.

O you who believe! Do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows his footsteps, then Satan only bids to indecency and abomination. And had there not been Allah's Grace upon you and His Mercy, not one of you could have ever been cleansed, but Allah cleanses whoever He will. And Allah is Hearing, Knowing.

And let not the men of affluence and plenty among you swear off from giving to the kindred and the needy and the emigrants in the way of Allah; let them pardon and overlook. Do you not love that Allah should forgive you? And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Verily those who accuse chaste, unknowing, believing women shall be cursed in the world and the Hereafter, and for them shall be a mighty chastisement.
On the Day when their tongues and hands and feet will bear witness against them for what they used to do.
On that Day Allah shall pay them their recompense in full and they shall know that Allah is Manifestly True.

Vile women are for vile men, and vile men are for vile women, and clean women are for clean men and clean men are for clean women; these are quit of what the people say. And for them is forgiveness and an honoured provision.
O you who believe! Do not enter houses other than your own until you have asked leave and invoked peace on their inmates. That is better for you; perhaps you may take heed.
That if you find no one therein, do not enter until leave has been given you. And if you are told: Go back, then go back. It is cleaner for you, and Allah is Knower of what you do.
No fault it is with you that you enter a house uninhabited in which there is some property for you; Allah Knows what you disclose and what you conceal.
Say you to the faithful that they shall lower their sights and guard their private parts; that is cleaner for them. Verily Allah is Aware of what they perform.

And say to the believing women that they shall lower their sights and guard their private parts and shall not disclose their adornment except what appears of it: And they shall draw their shawls over their bosoms, and shall not disclose their adornment save to their husbands or their fathers or their husband’s fathers or their sons or their husband’s sons or their brothers or their brothers’ sons or their sisters’ sons or their women or what their right hands own or male followers wanting in sex desire or children not acquainted with the privy parts of women. And they shall not strike their feet so that there be known what they hide of their adornment. And turn penitently to Allah you all, O you faithful! Perhaps you may thrive.
And wed the single among you and the fit ones among you male and female slaves. If they are poor, Allah will enrich them of His bounty. Allah is Ample, Knowing.

And those who do not find means to marry shall restrain themselves until Allah enriches them of His bounty. And from among those whom your right hands own those who seek writing, write it for them if you find any good in them, and give them of the wealth of Allah which He has given you. And do not constrain your handmaids to harlotry if they would live chastely, in order that you may seek the chance gain of this world. And whoever will constrain them, then verily Allah is, after their constraint, Forgiving, Merciful.
And assuredly We have sent down to you revelations illuminating and a similitude for those who passed away before you and an exhortation to the God-fearing.

Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth; the likeness of His Light is as a niche wherein is a lamp; the lamp is in glass; the glass is as though it is a star brilliant; lit from a tree blessed, an olive, neither of the East nor of West; its very oil will shine forth, even though no fire touched it; Light upon Light. Allah guides unto His Light whom He Will. Allah propounds similitudes for mankind, and verily Allah is the Knower of everything.
They worship in houses which Allah has bidden to be exalted and His Name to be remembered therein; they hallow Him therein in mornings and evenings.
Men whom neither trade nor business diverts from the remembrance of Allah and the establishment of the Şalāt and the payment of Zakāt, in awe of a Day whereon heart and sights will be upset.
That Allah may recompense them the best for what they worked and may increase to them of His Grace. And Allah propounds for whom He will without measure.

And those who disbelieve their works are like a mirage in a desert which the thirsty deems to be water until when he comes thereto, he finds nothing, and finds Allah with himself, and He pays him his account in full; and Allah is Swift in reckoning.

Or, like darkness in a bottomless sea; there covers him a wave from above it, a wave overcast with a cloud; layers upon layers of darkness. When he puts out his hand he can scarcely see it. And to whom Allah does not appoint a light, his shall be no light.

Do you not see that Allah; hallow Him whoever is in the heavens and the earth and the birds with wings outspread? Surely everyone knows his prayer and his hallowing; and Allah is the Knower of what they do.
Allah's is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and to Allah is the return.

Do you not see that Allah drives a cloud along, then compresses it, and then makes it a mass, and you then see fine water come forth from between them. And He sends down from the sky mountains in which is hail; then smites with it whom He will and spares whom He will. The flash of His lightning almost takes away the sights.
Allah turns away the night and the day over and over, verily in this is a lesson for men of insight.

Every moving thing Allah has created of water, of them is one that walks upon its belly, and of them is one that walks upon its two feet, and of them is one that walks upon its four. Allah creates whatever He wishes; Allah is Potent over everything.
Assuredly We have sent down revelations illuminating: And Allah guides whom He wishes to a straight path.
And they say: We have believed in Allah and the Messenger, and we obeyed, then a party of them backslides thereafter, and believers they are not.
And when they are called to Allah and His Messenger that he may adjudge between them, lo! a party of them turns aside.
And if they had a just cause, they would have come to him readily.
Is there in their hearts a disease? Or do they doubt? Or do they fear that Allah shall misjudge them, as also His Messenger? Aye! These are the very wrong-doers.
The only saying of the faithful, when they were called to Allah and His Messenger that he might judge between them was that they said: We hear and we obey. And these! They are the blissful.
And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, and is in awe of Allah and fears Him; These! They are the triumphant.
And they swear by Allah with their solemn oaths that if you command them they will surely go forth. Say you: Do not swear, your obedience is well-known. Verily Allah is Aware of what you do.

Say you: Obey Allah and obey the Messenger, then if you turn away, upon him is only that which has been laid upon him and upon you is that which has been laid upon you. If you obey him you will be guided, and nothing is upon the Prophet except the plain preaching.

Allah has promised those of you who believe and work the righteous deeds that He shall make them successors on the earth even as He made those who were before them successors, and that He shall certainly establish for them their religion which He has approved for them, and that He shall certainly exchange unto them after fear a security, provided they worship Me, joining nothing with Me; and whoever will disbelieve thereafter, then those! They are the ungodly.
And establish the Şalāt, and pay the Zakāt and obey the Messenger, perhaps you may be shown Mercy.
Do not consider them who disbelieve able to frustrate His Purpose on the earth, and their abode shall be the Fire, an ill retreat!

O you who believe! Let those whom your right hands own and those of you who have not attained puberty ask leave of you three times before the morning Şalāt, and when you lay aside your garments at noon-day and after the night Şalāt; three times of privacy for you. No fault is there upon you and upon them beyond these times going round upon you, some of you upon some others. In this way does Allah expound His Commandments, and Allah is Knowing, Wise.
And when the children among you attain puberty then let them also ask leave as those before them asked leave. In this way Allah expounds His Commandments; and Allah is Knowing, Wise.

And past child-bearing women who do not expect wed-lock; upon them it is no fault that they lay aside their outer garments not flaunting their adornment. And that they should restrain themselves is better for them; and Allah is Hearing, Knowing.

No restriction is there on the blind, nor is there a restriction on the lame, nor is there a restriction on the sick, nor on yourselves that you eat in your houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your uncles or the houses of your paternal aunts or the houses of your maternal uncles or the houses of your maternal aunts or from that house of which you own the keys or from the house of a friend. No fault is there upon you whether you eat together or eat in separate groups. Then when you enter houses, salute each other with a greeting from Allah, blessed and good. Thus Allah expounds to you His Revelation, perhaps you may reflect.

The faithful are those who have believed in Allah and His Messenger, and when they are with him on some affair collecting people together, they do not depart till they have begged his leave. Verily those who ask your leave, those are they who really believe in Allah and His Messenger. So if they ask your leave for some business of theirs, give you leave to whom you will, and implore you Allah for their forgiveness. Verily Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

Do not place the Messenger ’s calling of you on the same footing as your calling of each other. Of a surety Allah knows them who slip away privately. Let, therefore, those who oppose His Commandment beware lest there befall them a trial or there befall them an afflictive torment.

Lo! Verily Allah's is whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Surely He Knows what you are about, and the Day whereon they shall be made to return to Him, then He will declare to them what they worked. And Allah is the Knower of everything.
Blessed be He Who has sent down the Criterion to His bondman that he may be a warner to the worlds.

He it is Whose is the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Who has not taken a son, and for Whom there is not an associate in the dominion, and Who has created everything and measured it according to measurement.
And they have taken gods, besides Him, creating nothing and are themselves created, can neither hurt nor benefit themselves, and have no power of life or death or resurrection.
And those who disbelieve say: This is nothing but a falsehood that he has fabricated and other people have associated themselves in it. Surely they have brought a wrong and falsehood.
And they say: Fables of the ancients which he has had written down and they are dictated to him morning and evening.
Say you: He has sent it down Who knows the secret of the heavens and the earth; verily He is ever Forgiving, Merciful.
And they say: What is the matter with this Messenger, he eats food and walks about in the market! Why is not an angel sent down on him that he may be along with him a warner.
Or why is not cast down unto him a treasure or unto him a garden whereof he may eat? And the wrongdoers say: You follow merely a man bewitched.
See how they propound similitudes for you! So they have strayed and cannot find a way.
Blessed be He Who, if He willed, will assign to you something better than that; gardens with running water, and will assign palaces to you.
Aye! They belie the Hour, and for him who belies the Hour We have prepared a Flame.
When it sees them from afar, they will hear it raging and roaring.
And when they shall be flung into a strait place thereof, bound up, they shall call therein for death.
Call not today for a single death, but call for death manifold.
Say you: Is that better or the Garden of Abidance promised to those who fear Him. It shall be theirs as a recompense and as a retreat.
Therein shall be all that they wish for, as abiders: a promise from your Rabb to be asked for.
And on the Day when He will gather them and what they worship besides Allah and will say: Are you the ones who sent My these bondmen astray or strayed they themselves from the way?

They will say: Hallowed be You! It behoves us not that we should take besides You any patron, but You allowed them and their fathers enjoyment until they forgot the admonition and they were a people doomed.
So now they believe you in regard to what you said; so now you are not able to obtain diversion nor help. And whoever of you does wrong, him We shall cause to taste a great torment.

And We have not sent before you any of the Messengers but they did eat food and did walk about in the market-places. And We have made some of you a temptation to some others; will you have patience? And your Rabb is a Beholder.

And those who look not to their meeting with Us say: Why are not angels sent down to us, or why we see not our Rabb? Assuredly they have proved stiff-necked in their souls and have exceeded the bounds with great excess.
The Day they will see the angels there will be no joy for the culprits on that Day, and they will say: away! away!
And We shall set upon what they worked, and shall make it as dust wind-scattered.
Fellows of the Garden shall be on that Day in a goodly abode and a goodly repose.
And on the Day when the sky shall be rent asunder from the clouds and the angels shall be sent down with a great descending.
The dominion on that Day shall be the true dominion of the Compassionate, and it shall be a Day hard on the infidels.
On the Day when the wrong-doer shall gnaw his hands saying: Would that I had taken a way with the Messenger!
Ah! Woe unto me! Would that I had not taken such a one for a friend!
Assuredly he led me away from the admonition after it had come to me; verily Satan is to man ever a betrayer.
And the Messenger will say: Rabb! Verily my people took this Qurān as a thing to be.
And even so We appointed to every Messenger an enemy from among the culprits. And suffices your Rabb as Guide and Helper.
And those who disbelieve say: Why is the Qurān not revealed to him entire at once? We revealed it thus that We may strengthen your heart with it and We have repeated it with a repetition.
And they come not to you with a similitude but We bring you the truth and an excellent interpretation.
They who shall be gathered prone on their faces into Hell - those shall be the worst in respect of place and the most astray in respect of path.
And assuredly We gave the Book to Mūsa and We placed his brother Harūn with him as a minister.
Then We said: Go you twain to a people who have belied Our Signs. Then We annihilated them utterly.
And the people of Nūḥ! When they belied Our Messengers We drowned them and made them a portent for mankind. And We have prepared for the ungodly an afflictive torment.
And the ‘Aād and the Thamūd and the dwellers in Ar-Rass and many a generation.
And for each of them We propounded a similitude and each We ruined completely.
Assuredly they have passed by the town on which was rained the evil rain. Are they not used to seeing it? Aye! They expect no resurrection.
And when they see you, they hold you up for mockery: is he the one whom Allah has sent as an envoy?
Well-nigh he had led us astray from our gods if we had not persevered towards them. Presently they shall know, when they see the torment, who was more astray in respect of path.
Have you seen him who has taken as his god his own desire? Will you be a trustee over him?
Do you think that most of them hear or understand? They are but like the cattle; nay, they are even farther astray from the path.
Have you not observed your Rabb - how He has stretched out the shadow? And if He had willed, He would have made it still. Then We have made the sun for it an indication.
Then We draw it towards Us with an easy drawing.
And it is He Who has made for you the night a covering, and the sleep a repose, and has made the day a resurrection.
And it is He Who sends forth the winds as a herald before His Mercy: and We send down from the sky pure water.
That We may quicken thereby a dead land, and We may give drink from it to what We have created of the cattle and human beings in large number.
And We set it forth among them - that they may be admonished, but most men begrudge anything save infidelity.
And had We willed, We would have raised a warner in every town.
So obey not you the infidels, but strive against them with a great striving.
And it is He Who has mixed the two oceans; this, sweet and thirst-quenching; that, saltish and bitter, and has placed between the two a barrier and a partition complete.
And it is He Who has created man from water, and then made kinship for him by blood and wedlock. And your Rabb is ever Potent.
And yet they worship besides Allah, what can neither benefit them nor hurt them; and the infidel is ever a helper of the devil against the Rabb.
And We sent you but as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.
Say you: I ask of you no wage for this, save that whoever wills may take a way unto his Rabb.
And trust in the Living One Who dies not, and hallow His Praise. It suffices that He is aware of the sins of His bondmen.
Who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is in-between them in six days, then He established Himself on the Throne – the Compassionate! So concerning Him, ask any one informed.

And when it is said to them: Prostrate yourselves before the Compassionate, they say: What is this Compassionate? Shall we prostrate ourselves unto what you command us? And it increases in them only aversion. And when it is said to them: Prostrate yourselves before the Compassionate, they say: What is this? Shall we prostrate ourselves unto what you command us? And it increases in them only aversion.
Blessed be He Who has placed big stars in the sky and has placed therein a lamp and a moon enlightening.
And it is He Who has assigned the night and the day a succession, for him who wishes to consider or who wishes to be grateful.
And the servants of the Compassionate are these who walk upon the earth meekly, and when the ignorant address them, they say: peace.
And those who pass the night before their Rabb prostrate and standing up.
And those who say: Our Rabb! Avert from us the torment of Hell; verily its torment is anguish.
Verily ill it is as an abode and as a station.
And those who when they expend are neither extravagant nor stingy; and it is a medium in between.

And those who do not call on other gods along with Allah, and do not slay any soul which Allah has forbidden, save in justification; and do not commit adultery. And whoever will do this, shall pay the penalty.
Multiplied for him shall be the torment on the Day of Resurrection, and he shall abide therein disgraced.
Save he who repents and believes and works righteous works. Then these! For them Allah shall change their vices into virtues. Verily Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.
And whoever repents and works righteously, then surely he repents toward Him with a true repentance.
And also those who do not witness falsehood, and when they pass by some vanity, they pass by with dignity.
And also those who when reminded of the revelations of Allah, fall not deaf and blind thereat.
And those who say: O our Rabb! Bestow on us coolness of eyes from our wives and our offspring, and make us a leader unto the God-fearing.
Those shall be rewarded with the highest apartment, because of their fortitude; and there they shall be met with a greeting and salutation.
Abiders therein; excellent it is an abode and as a station.
Say you: My Rabb does not care for you were it not for your prayer whereas you have ever belied, so presently this denial shall come as cleaving punishment.
Tā Sīn Mīm.
These are the verses of a luminous Book.
Perhaps you shall kill yourself with grief because they do not become believers.
If We can send down to them a Sign from the heavens so that their necks would become submissive to it.
And there comes not to them any fresh admonition from the Compassionate but they are used to by turning away therefrom.
So they have surely belied; so presently there shall appear to them the truth of what they have been mocking at.
Do they not observe the earth - how We cause to grow therein every manner of fruit?
Verily therein is a Sign, but most of them are not believers.
And verily your Rabb! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
And recall when your Rabb said to Musa: Go you to an ungodly people.
The people of Pharaoh, they fear Me not.
Musa said: Rabb! I fear he will belie me.
And my breast straitens and my tongue moves not quickly: so, send for Harun.
And they have a crime against me; so I fear they shall slay me.
Allah said: By no means! So go both of you with Our Signs; I shall be with you listening.
So go both of you to the Pharaoh and say: We are the Messengers of the Rabb of the worlds.
Send with us the Children of Israil.
The Pharaoh said: Did we not bring you up among us as a child, and you stayed with us many years of your life?
And you did the deed you did; and you are of the ingrates.
Musa said: I did the deed when I was mistaken.
Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Rabb bestowed on me judgment and made me one of the envoys.
And the favour with which you did oblige me was that you had enslaved the Children of Isrāil.
The Pharaoh said: And what is this Rabb of the worlds?
Mūsa said: Rabb of the heavens and the earth and whatever is inbetween, if you seek to be convinced.
The Pharaoh said to those around him in amazement: Do you not hear?
Mūsa said: Your Rabb and Rabb of your ancestors.
The Pharaoh said: The Messenger sent to you is mad indeed.
Mūsa said: Rabb of the East and the West and whatever is in between, if you care to understand.
The Pharaoh said: If you will take a god other than me, I shall surely place you among the prisoners.
Mūsa said: What, even if I bring to you something evident.
The Pharaoh said: Forthwith it then, if you are of the truthtellers.
Then he cast down his rod, and it was a serpent manifest.
And he drew forth his hand, and it was white unto the beholders.
The Pharaoh said to the chiefs around him: verily he is a magician.
He would drive you out of your land through his magic, what is it then that you command?
They said: Put him off and his brother, and send callers to the cities.
That they may bring to you every magician knowing.
So the magicians were assembled at a set time on a day made known.
And it was said to the people: Are you gathering?
Likely we are to follow the wizards if they are the winners.
Then when the magicians came they said to the Pharaoh: Will there be a big reward for us if we are the winners?
He said: Yea; and you shall be of those brought nigh.
Mūsa said to them: Cast down what you have to cast.
Then they cast their ropes and their staves, and said: By the might of the Pharaoh we shall be the victors.
Then Mūsa cast his rod, and lo! it swallowed up what they had invented.
Then the magicians flung themselves prostrate.
They said: We now believe in the Rabb of the worlds.
The Rabb of Mūsa and Harūn.

The Pharaoh said: You believed before I gave you leave. Surely he is your chief who taught you magic; so you shall surely come to know. I shall certainly cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and certainly I shall crucify you all.
They said: No harm! Verily to our Rabb we are to return.
We long that our Rabb shall forgive us our faults as we have been the first of believers.
And We revealed to Mūsa: Depart by night with My bondmen; certainly you will be pursued.
Then the Pharaoh sent callers to the cities.
Verily these are but a small band.
And verily they have enraged us.
And we are the host well- provided.
Then We drove them from gardens and streams.
And treasurers and a noble station.
Even so. And We caused the Children of Isrāil to inherit them.
And they pursued them at sunrise.
And when the two parties saw each other the companions of Mūsa said: Verily we are overtaken.
Mūsa said: By no means! With me is my Rabb; He shall guide me.
Then We revealed to Mūsa: smite the sea with your staff. So it became separated, and each part was like a mighty mount.
And near We brought there the others on.
And We delivered Mūsa and those with him together.
Then We drowned the others.
Verily herein is a Sign, yet most of them are not believers.
And verily your Rabb! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
And recite to them the story of Ibrāhīm.
When he said to his father and his people: What do you worship?
They said: We worship idols, and to them we are ever devoted.
He said: Do they hear you when you cry?
Or do they benefit you, or do they hurt you?
They said: Nay, but we found our fathers doing in this way.
He said: Have you observed what you have been worshipping?
You and your forefathers?
Verily they are an enemy to me, save the Rabb of the worlds.
Who has created me, and He guides me.
He Who feeds me and gives me to drink.
And when I sicken, then He gives me health.
And He Who will cause me to die, and then will quicken me.
And He Who, I long, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Requital.
Rabb! Bestow on me wisdom, and join me with the righteous.
And assign to me an honourable mention among the posterity.
And make me of the inheritors of the Garden of Delight.
And forgive my father, verily he is of the erring.
And do not humiliate me on the Day when mankind will be raised.
The Day whereon neither riches nor sons will be of any avail.
Unless it be he, who shall bring to Allah a whole heart.
And the Garden will be brought nigh of the God-fearing.
And the Fierce Fire will be made apparent to the seduced ones.
And it will be said to them: Where is that which you used to worship.
Besides Allah? Can they succour you or succour even themselves?
Then they will be hurled therein, they and those seduced.
And the hosts of Iblis together.
And they while contending therein will say.
By Allah, we have indeed been in error manifest.
When we equalled you with the Rabb of the worlds.
And none led us astray except the culprits.
So none we have as intercessors.
Nor any loving friend.
Were there for us a return we would be of the believers.
Verily in this story is a Sign, yet most of them are not believers.
And truly your Rabb! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
And Nūḥ's people belied Our envoys.
When their brother Nūḥ said to them: Do you not fear?
Verily I am unto you a trusted Messenger.
So fear Allah and obey me.
And I ask of you no wage for it, my wage is but with the Rabb of the worlds.
So fear Allah and obey me.
They said: shall we believe in you when the meanest of us are your followers?
He said: I have no knowledge of what they have been working.
Their reckoning is upon my Allah, if you but know.
And I am not to drive away the believers.
I am not but a manifest warner.
They said: If you desist not, you shall be of those stoned.
He said: Rabb! My people have belied me.
So decide You between us and them, and deliver me and those who are with me of the believers.
Therefore, We delivered him and those with him in a laden Ark.
Then We drowned the rest thereafter.
Verily in this story is a Sign, yet most of them are not believers.
And your Rabb! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
The A'ad belied our envoys.
When their brother Hud said to them: Fear you not'?
Verily I am unto you a trusted Messenger.
So fear Allah and obey me.
And I ask of you no wage for it; my wage is but with the Rabb of the worlds.
Do you build on every eminence a landmark in vanity?
And do you take for yourselves castles that perhaps you may abide?
And when you seize you seize like tyrants
So fear Allah and obey me.
And fear Him Who has aided you with all that you know.
He has aided you with the cattle and sons.
And gardens and springs.
Verily I fear for you the torment of a mighty Day.
They said: It is equal to us whether you admonish or are you not of the admonishers.
This is but a custom of the ancients.
And we are not going to be tormented.
And they belied him; so We destroyed them. Verily in this story is a Sign; yet most of them are not believers.
And verily your Rabb! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
The Thamūd belied our envoys.
When their brother Sāliḥ told them: fear you not?
Verily I am unto you a trusted Messenger.
So fear Allah and obey me.
And I ask you no wage for it, my wage is but with the Rabb of the worlds.
Will you be left secure in what is before us?
In gardens and springs.
And cornfields and palm-trees of which the spathes are fine?
And do you hew out in the rocks houses skilfully?
So fear Allah and obey me.
And do not follow the bidding of the extravagant.
Who act corruptly in the land and do not rectify.
They said: You are but one of the bewitched.
You are but a human being like us. So bring you a Sign if you are of the truthful.
He said: Yonder is a she-camel; to her is a drink, and to you is a drink, each on a day known.
And do not touch her with an evil, lest there takes hold of you the torment of a mighty Day.
Then they hamstrung her, then they became regretful.
So the chastisement overtook them. Verily in this story is a Sign, yet most of them are not believers.
And verily your Rabb! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
Then people of Lut belied our envoys.
When their brother Lut said to them: Fear you not?
Verily I am unto you a trusted Messenger.
So fear Allah and obey me.
And I ask of you no wage for it, my wage is but with the Rabb of the worlds.
Do you go in, of all creatures, unto the males?
And do you leave your spouses your Rabb has created for you? Aye! You are a people trespassing.
They said: If you desists not, O Lūṭ! You shall be of those driven forth.
He said: Verily I am of those who abhor what you do.
Rabb! Deliver me and my household from what they work.
So We delivered him and his household all.
Save an old woman among the lingerers.
Thereafter We annihilated the rest.
And We rained on them a rain — ill was the rain on those warned.
Verily in this story is a Sign, yet most of them are not believers.
And verily your Rabb! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
The dwellers of the wood belied Our envoys.
When their brother Shu’aib said to them: Fear you not?
Verily I am unto you a trusted Messenger.
So fear Allah and obey me.
And I ask you no wage; my wage is but with the Rabb of the worlds.
Give full measure, and be not of those who cause others to lose.
And weigh with a straight balance.
And defraud not people of their things, and commit not corruption on the earth.
So fear Him Who created you and the former generations.
They said: You are but of the bewitched.
And you are but a human being like us, and we consider you to be of the liars.
So cause you a fragment of the sky to fall upon us, if you are of the truthful.
He said: My Rabb is the Best Knower of what you work.
Then they belied him. Wherefore there seized them torment of the Day of Shadow. Verily it was the torment of a mighty Day.
Verily in this story is a Sign; yet most of them are not believers.
And verily your Rabb! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
Verily it is a revelation of the Rabb of the worlds.
The Trusted Spirit has brought it down.
Upon your heart, that you may be of the warners.
In plain Arabic speech.
And verily it is in the Scriptures of the ancients.
Is it not evidence with them that the learned among the Children of Isrā'īl know it?
And had We Revealed it to any of the non-Arabs.
And he had read it unto them; even then they would not have been believers in it.
Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.
They will not believe in it until they see the afflictive torment.
It shall come unto them suddenly, and they will not perceive.
Then they will say: Are we to be respited?
Do they then wish to hurry Our chastisement?
Think! If We let them enjoy for years.
And then there comes to them what they had been promised.
Those shall not avail them what they enjoyed.
Not a city We destroyed but it had its warners.
By way of admonition, and We have never been unjust.
And it is not the devils who have brought it down.
Neither it behoves them, nor they can.
Verily very far from its hearing are they removed.
So call not you upon another god along with Allah lest you be doomed.
And warn your clan, the nearest ones.
And behave you with kindness towards those who follow you as believers.
And if they disobey you, say you: I am quit of what you do.
And rely you upon the Mighty, the Merciful.
Who sees you when you stand up.
And your movement among those who fall prostrate.
Verily He! He is the Hearer, the Knower.
Shall I declare to you upon whom the devils descend?
They descend upon every calumniator, sinner.
Who give ear, and most of them are liars.
As for the poets, it is the deluded who follow them.
Do you not see that they wander aimlessly in every vale?
And that they say, what they do not act.

Save those who believe and work righteous deeds and remember Allah much and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. And those who do wrong shall presently come to know by what overturning they are being overturned.
Tā. Sīn. These are the verses of the Qurān and a Book luminous.
A guidance and glad tidings to the believers.
Who establish Şalāt and pay Zakāt and of the Hereafter they are convinced.
Verily those who do not believe in the Hereafter – fair-seeming to them We have made their works, so that they wander perplexed.
Those are they for whom there will be an ill chastisement, and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.
And surely you are receiving the Qurān from the presence of One Wise, Aware.
Recall when Mūsa came to his household and said: Verily I see a fire afar, I shall forthwith bring you tidings thereof, or bring you a brand lighted therefrom, that you may warm yourselves.
Then when he came to it, he was cried unto thus: Blessed is Whoever is in the fire and Whoever is around it, and hallowed be Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.
O Mūsa! It is really I, Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
And cast down your rod. Then when he saw it wriggling as though it was a serpent, he turned in flight and did not look back. Mūsa! Do not be alarmed, in My Presence the sent ones do not fear.
Excepting any who may have done wrong and thereafter changes evil for good; then verily I am Forgiving, Merciful.
And put your hand into your bosom, it shall come forth white, without any hurt: Among nine Signs to the Pharaoh and his people. Verily they have been a people transgressing.
Then when Our Signs came to them illuminating, they said: this is a magic manifest.
And they denied them, out of spite and arrogance, although their souls were convinced thereof. So behold! What has been the end of the corruptors.
And assuredly We vouchsafed to Daūd and Sulaiman, knowledge, and the twain said: Praise be to Allah who has preferred us to many of His believing bondmen!
And Sulaiman inherited from Daūd, and he said: O mankind! We have been taught the language of birds, and we have been vouchsafed of everything, and surely this is an evident grace.
And there were gathered unto Sulaiman his hosts of Jinn and mankind and birds, and they were set in bands.
And when they came to the valley of the ants, an ant said: Ants! Enter your habitations lest Sulaiman and his hosts may crush you while they perceive not.

So, amused at her speech, he smiled and said: Rabb! Dispose me that I should be grateful for the favour wherewith You have favoured me and my parents, and that I should work righteously pleasing You; and out of Your Mercy enter me among Your righteous bondmen.
And he sought after the birds and said: What is the matter that I do not see the hoop? Is he among the absentees?
I shall chastise him surely or I shall slaughter him unless he offers me a good explanation.
But he stayed away not long, and said: I have comprehended what you have not yet comprehended, and I came to you from Saba with a sure tiding.
I have found a woman ruling over them, and she has been vouchsafed of everything. And hers is a mighty throne.
I have found her and her people adoring the sun instead of Allah, and Satan has made their work fair seeming to them and has barred them from the way, as they are not guided.
So that they adore not Allah Who brings forth the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you declare.
Allah! There is no God but He! The Rabb of the Magnificent Throne.
Sulaiman said: We shall now see whether you have spoken the truth or whether you are of the liars.
Go you with this letter of mine, and cast it down unto them and turn aside from them, and see what they return.
She said: O Chiefs! There has been cast to us an honourable epistle.
It is from Sulaiman, and it runs: In the Name of Allah The Most Gracious, The Most Merciful.
Rise not against me, and come to me submissive.
She said: O Chiefs! Counsel me in the affair. I do not resolve on any affair until you counsel me.
They said: We possess great force and great might; but yours is the command, we shall see what you command.
She said: Verily the kings when they enter a city, despoil it and make its most powerful inhabitants the most abased; so they also will do.
Therefore, I am going to send them a present, and see with what answer the envoys come back.
Then when he came to Sulaiman, he said: Are you going to add riches to me while what Allah had vouchsafed to me is better than what He has vouchsafed to you. Aye! It is you who exult in your present.
Go back to them. Surely we shall come upon them with hosts which they cannot withstand and we shall drive them forth from their place abased and they will be humbled.
Sulaiman said: Chiefs! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me surrendering themselves.
A giant from the jinn said: I shall bring it to you before you arise from your seat; surely I am strong enough for test and am reliable.

But one who had some knowledge of the Book said: I shall bring it to you before your eye twinkles. Then when Sulaiman saw it placed before him, he said: This is of the Grace of my Rabb that He may test me whether I thank Him or I am ingrate. Whoever gives thanks only gives thanks for his own soul, and whoever is ungrateful then my Rabb is Self-Sufficient, Munificent.
He said: Disguise her throne, so that we may see whether she is guided or is of those who are not guided.
Then when she arrived, it was said: Is your throne like this? She said: It is as though it were it, and we have been vouchsafed the knowledge before this, and we have been Muslims.
And there hindered her what she worshipped instead of Allah; indeed she was of an infidel people.

It was said to her: Enter the palace. Then when she saw it, she imagined it a pool and bared her shanks. He said: It is a pavilion smoothed of crystal. She said: Rabb! I have wronged my soul, and I surrender myself together with Sulaiman to Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.
And assuredly we sent to Thamūd their brother Sālih, saying: worship Allah. Then lo! They became two parties contending.
He said: My people! Why do you seek to hasten the evil before the good? Why do you not seek the forgiveness of Allah, so that you may be shown Mercy?
They said: We augur ill of you and of those who are with you. He said: Your augury is with Allah. Aye! You are a people being tempted.
And there were nine of a group in the city, who spread corruption in the land and did not rectify.

They said: Swear by Allah one to another that we shall surely fall upon him and his household by night; and thereafter we shall tell his heir. We did not see the destruction of his household, and we are truthful.
And they plotted a plot, and We plotted a plot, and they perceived it not.
So behold you how was the end of their plot. Verily We annihilated them and their nation all together.
Yonder are their houses overturned, for they did wrong. Verily herein is a Sign for a people who know.
And We rescued them who believed and used to be God-fearing.
And recall Lūṭ! When he said to his people: Do you commit indecency while you see its enormity?
Would you go in lustfully to men instead of women? Aye! You are a people addicted to pagan ways.
There was no answer from his people save that they said: Drive forth the family of Lūṭ from your city. They are a people clean indeed.
Then We rescued Lūṭ and his family except his wife. Her We destined to be of the lingerers.
And We rained upon them a rain, ill was that rain upon the warned.
Say you: All praise to Allah, and peace upon His bondmen whom He has chosen. Is Allah Best, or what they associate with Him.

Is not He best Who has created the heavens and the earth, and Who sends down water for you from the sky whereby We cause beautiful orchards to grow up and the trees of which it was not possible for you to cause to grow up? Is there any other god along with Allah? Nay! Yet they are a people who equalise.

Is not He best Who has made the earth a fixed abode and has placed the rivers in its midst and has placed firm mountains on it, and has placed a barrier between the two seas? Is there any other god along with Allah? Nay! Yet most of them do not know.
Is not He best Who answers the distressed when he calls unto Him and averts the evil, and has made you the successors in the earth? Is there any other god along with Allah? Little do you reflect.

Is not He best Who guides you in the darknesses of the land and the sea and Who sends the winds as heralds before His Mercy? Is there any other god along with Allah? Exalted be Allah above that they associate with Him.

Is not He best Who originates creation, and shall thereafter restore it, and Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth? Is there any other god along with Allah? Say you: Bring you proofs if you are truthful.
Say you: None in the heavens and the earth knows the unseen save Allah, nor can they perceive when they will be raised.
Aye! Their knowledge does not attain to the Hereafter. Aye! They are in doubt about it. Aye! They are blind to it.
Those who disbelieve say: When we have become dust, we and our forefathers; shall we be brought forth?
Assuredly we have been promised this before, we and our forefathers. Nothing is this, but the fables of the ancients.
Say you: Travel in the land and behold how has been the end of the culprits.
Grieve you not over them, nor be straitened on what they plot.
And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful?
Say you: Perhaps close behind you may be what you would hasten on.
Verily your Rabb is full of Grace for mankind, yet most of them give not thanks.
Verily your Rabb knows what their breasts conceal and what they disclose.
And nothing there is hidden in the heaven and the earth but it is in a Book manifest.
Verily this Qurān recounts with truth to the Children of Isrāīl much of what they contend with.
And verily it is guidance and a mercy to the believers.
And verily your Rabb shall decide between them by His Judgement, and He is the Mighty, the Knowing.
So put your trust in Allah; verily you are on manifest truth.
Surely you cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they flee turning their backs.
Nor can you lead the blind out of their error. You can make none hear save those who believe in Our Signs and who have submitted themselves.
And when the word concerning them shall come to be fulfilled, We shall bring forth a beast of the earth speaking to them, that of Our Signs the people have not been convinced.
And remind them of the Day on which We shall gather from every community a troop of those who belied Our Signs, and they will be held in order.
Until when they will have come, He will say: Did you believe My Signs when you could not comprehend them in your knowledge; nay, what else was it that you have been working?
And the word concerning them shall be fulfilled because they did wrong and they shall not be able to speak.
Do they not consider that We have made the night that they may repose in it, and the day sight-giving. Verily in them are Signs for those who believe.
And remind them of the Day on which the Trumpet shall be blown, and terrified shall be those who are in the heavens and the earth, save him whom Allah wills. And all shall come to Him lowly.
And you shall see the mountains you deem solid passing away as the passing away of the clouds, the handiwork of Allah Who has perfected everything, Verily He is Aware of all that you do.
Whoever will bring good shall have better than its worth; and they will be secure from the terror of that Day.
And whoever will bring evil – their faces shall be cast down in the Fire. Are you being requited anything save what you have been working?
I am commanded only to worship the Rabb of this city which He has sanctified, and His is everything, and I am commanded to be of the Muslims.
And that I should recite the Qurān. And whoever receives guidance, receives it for his own soul, and as for him who strays, say you: I am only of the warners.
And say you: All praise to Allah. Presently He will show you His Signs, so that you will recognise them. And your Rabb is not heedless of what you do.
Tā. Sīn. Mīm.
These are verses of the manifest Book.
