Then if they suckle their children for you give them their wage, and take counsel together honourably. And if you make hardship for each other, then another woman shall suckle for him.

Let the affluent spend according to his means, and whoso is stinted in his subsistence, let him spend of what Allah has given him. Allah does not task any soul except according to what He has vouchsafed it. Allah will soon appoint ease for hardship.
And how many a city trespassed the Commandment of its Rabb and His Messengers. So We reckoned with them sternly and inflicted on them a chastisement unheard of.
So they tasted the ill consequence of their affairs, and loss was the end result of their affair.
Allah has prepared for them a grievous punishment; so fear Allah, O' men of understanding! Those who have believed. Surely He has sent down unto you an Admonition.

A Messenger reciting the revelations of Allah as evidences, that he may bring forth those who believe and work righteous works from darkness unto light. And whoso believes in Allah and works righteously, him He shall cause to enter the Gardens whereunder rivers flow as abiders therein for ever. Surely Allah has made for them an excellent provision.

Allah it is Who has created seven heavens and of the earth the like thereof. His Commandment comes down between them; so that you may know that Allah is Potent over everything, and that Allah does encompass everything in His Knowledge.
O Prophet! Why do you forbid for you what Allah has allowed to you, seeking the goodwill of your wives? And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Surely Allah has ordained for you absolution from your oaths; and Allah is your Patron, and He is the Knower, the Wise.

And recall when the Prophet confided a story to one of his spouses, and then she disclosed it. Allah apprised him of it; he made known a part of it, and a part he withheld. Then when he had apprised her of it, she said: Who has told you of it? He said: The Knower, the Aware has told me.

Then if you twain turn to Allah repentant, it is well; surely your hearts are so inclined. But if you support each other against him, then verily Allah! his friend is He and Jibril, and so are the righteous believers, and furthermore angels are his aiders.
If he divorces you, perchance his Rabb will give him in exchange better wives than you: Muslims, believers, devout, penitent, worshippers, given to fasting, both virgins and virgins.

O you who believe! Guard yourselves and your households against a Fire the fuel whereof is mankind and stones. Over it are angels, stern, strong; they do not disobey Allah in what He Commands them, and they do what they are commanded.
O you who disbelieve! Excuse not yourselves today; you are only being requited for what you have been working.

O you who believe! Turn to Allah with a sincere repentance, May be your Rabb will expiate from you your misdeeds and cause you to enter Gardens whereunder rivers flow, on the Day whereon Allah will not humiliate the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will be running before them and on their right hands, and they will say: Our Rabb! Perfect for us our light, and forgive us: Verily You are Potent over everything.
O Prophet! Strive hard against the infidels and the hypocrites, and be stern to them. And their abode is Hell; a hapless destination.

Allah propounded for those who disbelieve the similitude of the wife of Nūḥ and the wife of Lūṭ. They were under two of Our righteous bondmen, and then they defrauded them. Wherefore the twain availed them nothing against Allah, and it was said: Enter you twain the Fire with those who enter.

And Allah propounded for those who believe the similitude of the wife of the Pharaoh when she said: my Rabb! Build me in Your presence a house in the Garden and deliver me from the Pharaoh and his handiwork, and deliver me from the transgressing people.

And the similitude of Maryam daughter of 'Imran, who preserved her chastity, wherefore We breathed in it of Our Spirit. And she testified to the words of her Rabb and His Books and she was of the devout.
Blessed be He, in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and He is Potent over everything.
Who has created death and life, that He might test you as to which of you is excellent in work. And He is the Mighty, the Forgiver.
Who has created the seven heavens in storeys. You shall not find any crack in the creation of the Compassionate.
Then repeat your look twice over, and your look will return to you dim and drowsy.
And assuredly We have bedecked the nearest sky with lamps and We have made them missiles for pelting devils, and We have prepared for them the torment of the Blaze.
And for those who disbelieve in their Rabb will be the torment of Hell – a hapless destination!
When they will be cast in it, they will hear a braying as it boils up.
It almost bursts up with rage. So often as a company is cast in it, its keepers will ask them: Did not a warner come to you?
They will say: Surely a warner did come to us but we refuted him and said: Allah has not sent down anything, you are nothing but in a great error.
And they will say: Had we listened or reflected, we would not have been among the fellows of the Blaze.
So they will confess their sin. Far away be they, the fellows of the Blaze!
Those Who are in awe of their Rabb unseen, theirs shall be forgiveness and a great wage.
And whether you keep your discourse secret or disclose it, verily He is the Knower of what is in the breasts.
Will not He Who has created know? He is the Subtle, the Aware.
He it is Who has made the earth subservient to you, so go forth in the tracts thereof, and eat of His provision. And to Him is the Resurrection.
Are you secure that He Who is in the heaven will not sink the earth with you, and then it should quake?
Or are you securing that He Who is in the heaven will not send against you a whirlwind? Soon you shall know how has been My warning.
And assuredly those before them have belied, then how has been My Wrath?
Do they not see the birds above them outstretching their wings and also closing them? None sustains them except the Compassionate. Verily He is Beholder of everything.
Who is he, besides the Compassionate that can be an army unto you and succour you? The infidels are but in delusion.
Should He withhold His provision, who is he that can provide for you? Aye! They persist in perversity and aversion.
Is he, then, who goes about grovelling upon his face better directed or he who walks evenly on a straight path?
Say you: He it is Who has brought you forth and has endowed you with hearing and sights and hearts. Little thanks it is you give!
Say you: He it is Who has spread you over the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered.
And they say: When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful.
Say you: The knowledge thereof is only with Allah, and I am but a manifest warner.
But when they will see it approximating, sad will be the countenances of those who disbelieve, and it will be said: This is what you have been calling for.
Say you: Think! If Allah destroys me and those with me, or have Mercy on us, who will protect the infidels from an afflictive torment?
Say you: He is the Compassionate; in Him we have believed, and in Him we have put our trust. And soon you will know who it is that is in manifest error.
Say you: think! Were your water to be sunk away, who then could bring you water welling-up?
Nun, By the pen and by what they inscribe.
Through the Grace of your Rabb. You are not mad.
And verily for you will be an unending wage.
And verily you are of a high and noble disposition.
Soon you will see and they will see.
Which of you is afflicted with madness.
Verily your Rabb is the best Knower of him who has strayed from the path and the best Knower of him who is the guided one.
So do not obey you the beliers.
They would like that you should be a pliant, so that they also will be a pliant.
And do not obey you any ignominious swearer.
Defamer, spreader abroad of slander.
Hinderer of the good, trespasser, sinner.
Gross, and moreover ignoble.
And thus, because he is owner of riches and children.
When Our revelations are rehearsed to him he says: Fables of the ancients.
Soon We shall brand him on the snout.
Verily We! We have tried them even as We tried the men of a garden when they swore that they would surely pluck it in the morning.
And they made in the assertion no reservation.
Wherefore there visited it an encircling visitation while they slept.
Then in the morning it became as if it had been plucked.
Then in the morning they cried out to each other.
Saying Go out early to your tilth if you would pluck.
Then they went off speaking to each other in a low voice.
Let there enter upon you no needy man today.
And they went out early determined in purpose.
Then when they saw it, they said: Indeed we are gone astray.
Alas! It is we who have been robbed!
And the most moderate of them said: Did I not tell you: Why do you not hallow Him?
They said now in repentance: Hallowed be Our Rabb! Verily we have been wrong doers.
Then they turned to each other reproaching.
They said: Woe to us! Surely we have been arrogant.
Perhaps our Rabb may exchange for us a better garden than this, verily we are beseechers to our Rabb.
Such is the chastisement, and the chastisement of the Hereafter is far greater, if they but knew.
Verily for the pious there are Gardens of Delight with their Rabb.
Shall We make the Muslims like the culprits?
How it is with you! How ill you judge!
Is there with you a Book wherein you study?
That therein is for you what you may choose?
Or, have you oaths from Us, reaching to the Day of Resurrection, that yours will be what you judge?
Ask them, which of them will stand thereof as a guarantee?
Have they associate gods? Let them produce their associate gods if they are truthful.
Remember the Day when the shank shall be bared and they shall be called upon to prostrate themselves, but they shall not be able.
Downcast will be their looks; abjectness will overspread them. Surely they had been called upon to prostrate themselves, but they shall not be able.
Let Me alone with him who belies this discourse; We lead them on by steps whence they perceive not.
And I bear with them. Verily My contrivance is sure.
Do you ask them a wage, so that they are laden with debt?
Is with them the Unseen, so that they write down Allah's Decrees?
Be you patient with your Rabb’s judgment, and do not be you like him of the fish, when he cried out, while he was in anguish.
Had there not reached him the Grace from his Rabb, he would surely have been cast into the wilderness in a plight.
Then his Rabb chose him and made him of the righteous.
And when those who disbelieve hear the admonition; they shall cause you to stumble with the stern looks, and they say: Indeed he is mad.
While it is nothing but an admonition to the worlds.
The Inevitable Calamity!
What is the Inevitable Calamity!
And what will make you know what the Inevitable Calamity is?
The tribes of Thamūd and ' Ād belied the Striking Day.
As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by an outburst.
And as for ' Ād, they were destroyed by a wind, furious, roaring.
To which He subjected them for seven nights and eight days in succession so that you might have seen men during it lying prostrate, as though they were stumps of palm ruined.
Do you see any remnant of them?
And the Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities committed sin.
And they disbelieved their Rabb’s Messenger, so He seized them with an increasing grip.
Verily We bore you, when the water rose, upon a traversing ark.
That We might make it an admonition unto you and that it might be retained by the retaining ears.
And when the Trumpet will sound a single blast.
And the earth and the mountains will be borne, and they will be crushed with a single crushing.
Then on that Day will happen the event.
And the heaven will be rent in asunder, frail it will be on that Day.

The Day whereon you will be mustered, nothing hidden by you will be hidden.
Then as to him, whose book will be vouchsafed to him in his right hand, he will say: Here! Read my record.
Verily I was sure that I would have to face my reckoning.

Of which the clusters will be near at hand.

Then as to him whose record will be vouchsafed to him in his left hand, he will say. Oh! Would that I had not been given my record at all.
Nor known what was my reckoning.
Oh! Would that it would have been the ending.

A questioner has questioned about chastisement about to befall.

For the beggar and the destitute.

As also those who guard their private parts.
Save in regard to their women and those whom their right hands own. So they are not reproachable.
And whoever seeks beyond that, then it is those who are the trespassers.
As also those who keep their trusts and their covenant.

Honoured, they shall dwell in Gardens.
What ails those who disbelieve, hastening towards you?

I swear by the Rabb of the East and West that We are Able.
To replace them by others better than they and We are not to be frustrated.

The Day whereon they will come forth from the graves hurrying as if they were hastening to an altar
Downcast shall be their looks, abjectness shall overwhelm them. Such is the Day they were promised.
Verily We! We sent forth Nūḥ to his people saying: Warn your people before there comes to them an afflictive chastisement.
He said: My people! I am to you a manifest warner.
Worship Allah, and fear Him, and obey me.
He will forgive you your sins, and will defer you to an appointed term. Verily the term of Allah, when it comes, shall not be deferred, if you but know.
He said: Rabb! Verily I have called my people night and day.

Verily whenever I call them, that You may forgive them, they place their fingers in their ears, and wrap themselves with their garments, and persist in their denial, and are stiff-necked.
Then I have called them aloud.

He will send down upon you rains copiously.

What ails you that you look not for majesty in Allah?
While He has created you by stages.

And He has placed the moon therein for a light and has made the sun for a lamp?
And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth as a growth.
And hence He will cause you to return to it and He will bring you forth completely.
And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse.
That of it you may traverse the open ways.
Nūḥ said: Rabb! Verily they have denied me and have followed him whose riches and children has only increased him in loss.
And they have plotted a tremendous plot.
And they have said: You shall not leave your gods, nor shall you leave Wadd nor Suwa nor Yaghuth nor Ya'uq nor Nasr.

And because of their misdeeds they were drowned, and then made to enter the Fire. Then they did not find for themselves any helpers.
And Nūḥ said: Rabb: Leave not of the infidels any inhabitant upon the earth.
For should You leave them, they will lead astray Your bondmen and will surely beget sinning infidels.
Rabb! Forgive me and my parents and him who enters my house as a believer, and all the faithful men and women, and increase not the ungodly save in perdition.
Say you, it has been revealed to me that a company of the Jinn listened and said: Verily we have listened to a Recitation wondrous.
Guiding to rectitude; so we have believed in it, and we shall not by any means associate any one with our Rabb.
And He, exalted be the majesty of our Rabb, has taken neither a wife nor a son.
And the foolish among us used to forge a lie against Allah exceedingly.
And verily we believed that neither man nor Jinn could ever forge a lie against Allah.
And persons among mankind have been seeking refuge with persons of the Jinn, so that they increased them in evil.
And indeed they imagined, as you too imagined, that Allah will not raise any one.
And we sought to reach the heaven, then we found it filled with a strong guard and darting meteors.

And we do not know whether evil is boded for those on the earth, or their Rabb intends for them a right direction.
And of us there are some righteous and of us are some otherwise; we have been following very diverse paths.
And we know that we cannot frustrate Allah in the earth, nor can we elude Him by flight.
And when we heard the Message of guidance we believed in it, and whoever believes in his Rabb, he shall fear neither diminution nor wrong.
And of us some are Muslims, and some are deviators. Then whoever has embraced Islam such have endeavoured after a path of rectitude.
And as to the deviators, they shall be firewood for Hell.
And had they kept to the right path, surely We would have watered them with plentiful rains.
That We might try them thereby. And whoever turns aside from the remembrance of his Rabb, him He shall thrust into a vehement torment.
And the places of worship are for Allah, so do not call along with Allah anyone.

Say you: I simply call upon Allah, and do not associate anyone with Him.

Say you: None can protect me from Allah, nor can I find besides Him any refuge.
Mine is but preaching from Allah and His Messages; and whosoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger, his portion is the Hell-fire, abiding there for ever.
They will go on denying until they see what they are promised. Then they will know who is weaker in protectors and fewer in number.
Say you: I do not know whether what you are promised is near, or whether my Rabb has appointed it for a distant term.
He is the Knower of the Unseen and He does not disclose His Unseen to anyone.

That He may know that they have delivered the messages of their Rabb. And He comprehends whatever is with them, and He keeps count of everything numbered.
O you enwrapped!
Keep vigil all night save a little.
Half of it, or a little less of it.

Verily We! Soon We shall be casting on you a weighty word.
Verily the rising by night is most curbing and most conducive to right speech.
Verily for you is the day a prolonged occupation.
And remember you the Name of your Rabb and devote yourself to Him exclusively.
Rabb of the East and the West! No god is there but He! So take Him for your trustee.

And let Me alone with the believers, owners of comfort and respite.

On a Day when the earth and mountains shall quake and the mountains shall become a sand-heap.

How then, if you deny, shall you escape, on a Day that will make children grey-headed.
And the sky will be split therein. His Promise is certainly to be accomplished.

Verily your Rabb Knows that you stay up near two-thirds of the night, or a half of it, or a third of it, and also a party of those who are with you. And Allah measures the night and the day. He Knows that you cannot compute it, so He has relented towards you. Recite now of the Qurān so much as is easy. He Knows that there will be among you some sick, and others shall be travelling in the land seeking Grace of Allah, and some others shall be fighting in the Cause of Allah. Recite of it, therefore, so much as is easy, and establish Şalāt, and pay Zakāt, and lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good you will send on for your souls, you will find it with Allah, better and greater in reward. And beg forgiveness of Allah; verily Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
O you enveloped!

Scorching the skin.
Over it are appointed nineteen angels.

And We have appointed none but the angels to be wardens of the Fire. And We have made this number only a trial for them who disbelieve, so that those who are vouchsafed the Book may be convinced, and that the faithful may increase in faith, and that those who are vouchsafed the Book and the faithful may not dubitate, and that those in whose heart is a disease and the infidels may utter: what does Allah mean by this description? Thus does Allah send astray whom He will, and guide whom He will. And none knows the hosts of your Rabb but He. And this is not but an admonition to man.

Yes! We are Able to put together evenly his very fingertips.

And He made of him the two sexes, male and female.
Is not That One then Able to quicken the dead?

Verily We have prepared for the infidels chains and collars and a Blaze.

They are those who fulfil their vow, and dread a Day the evil of which shall be wide-spreading.
And they feed for love of Him, with food the destinate, the orphan and the captive.
Saying: We feed you only for the sake of Allah; we desire not from you any recompense or thanks.

Wherefore Allah shall protect them from the evil of that Day, and shall cause them to enjoy radiance and pleasure.
And their recompense shall be for they bore patiently, a Garden and silken rainment.
They shall recline therein on couches and shall feel neither scorching sun nor exceeding cold.
And close upon them will be the shades thereof, and low will hang the clusters thereof greatly.
And brought round amongst them will be vessels of silver and also goblets of glass.
Goblets of silver, they shall have filled them to exact measure.
And therein they shall drink of a cup whose admixture will be ginger.
And this from a fountain therein, named Salsabā.
And there shall go round unto them youths ever-young. When you see them; you would deem them pearls unstrung.

Verily this is for you by way of recompense, and your endeavour has been accepted.
Verily it is We Who have revealed to you the Qurān, a gradual revelation.

Woe to that Day to the beliers!

Woe to that Day to the beliers!
Did We not create you of despicable water?

Till a time limited!
So We decreed. How excellent are We as Decriers!
Woe to the beliers!
Have We not placed earth a receptacle?
Both for the living and the dead.
And have placed therein firm and tall mountains and given you to drink of fresh water?
Woe to that Day to the beliers!
Depart unto what you were used to believe.
Depart unto the shadows three branched.
Neither shading nor availing against the flame.
Verily it shall cast forth sparks like unto a castle.
As though they were camels yellow, tawny.
Woe to that Day to the beliers!
This is a Day when they shall not be able to speak.
Nor shall they be permitted, so that they might excuse themselves.
Woe to that Day to the beliers!
This is the Day of Decision. We have assembled you and the ancients.
If now you have any craft, try that craft upon Me.
Woe to that Day to the beliers!
Verily those who keep their duty to Allah shall be amid shades and springs.
And fruits such as they desire.
Eat and drink with relish for what you have been working.
Verily We! In this way recompense the well-doers.
Woe on that Day to the beliers!
Eat and drink but little; you are culprits.
Woe on that Day to the beliers!
And when it is said: Bow down, they do not bow down.
Woe on that Day to the beliers!
In what discourse then, after it will they believe?
Of what are they asking?
Of the fateful Announcement.
Concerning which they differ.
No, indeed they shall soon know the truth.
Again, no indeed, they shall soon know the truth.
Have We not made the earth an expanse?
And the mountains as stakes?
And we have created you in pairs.
And We have made your sleep a rest.
And We have made the night a covering.
And We have made the day for seeking livelihood.
And We have built over you seven strong heavens.
And We have set therein a lamp glowing.
And We have sent down from the rain-clouds abundant water.
So that We bring forth from them corn and vegetation.
And gardens thick with trees.
Verily the Day of Decision is an appointed time.
A Day whereon the Trumpet will be blown and you will come in multitudes.
And the sky will have been opened and it will have become as doors.
And the mountains will have been removed away, and they will have become as mirage.
Verily Hell lurks in ambush.
A receptacle for the exorbitant.
